selection_rule: First ten available subject IDs in ascending order, first session; no image-derived QC or outcome-based selection
image_checks: Only HTTP 206 first 64 KiB compressed header ranges; voxel data not downloaded or evaluated
checksum_note: Pinned upstream annex uses MD5E for NIfTI files. These MD5 digests and sizes match single-part S3 ETags and listing sizes; compute and retain local SHA256 after complete downloads.
known_acquisition_limitations: Shell-dependent TE 104/113/125 ms; do not treat the benchmark as validation of physiological NODDI model assumptions.
Some shell2/shell3 PA IntendedFor links incorrectly point to shell1. Explicit filenames and actual matching spatial headers must determine association.
